data.name: Dheer
data.gender_notes: Dheer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dheer is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dhira’ meaning ‘calm, stable, and steady’. In Hindu mythology, Dheer is a name for Lord Shiva, representing his unwavering nature and immense power. The name Dheer carries the meaning “Valiant, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dheer usually hope their child will grow to embody valiant, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dheer belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Valiant, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dheer total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
